data.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Double Agent®
data.detailed_description:
JOGABILIDADE DE AGENTE DUPLO, HISTÓRIA RAMIFICADA

Experimente a tensão implacável e os dilemas terríveis da vida de um agente duplo. Jogue dos dois lados e faça escolhas cruciais entre objetivos conflitantes da NSA e dos terroristas. Você decide quem apoiar e a quem sabotar. Faça o que for preciso, não estrague seu disfarce e ganhe a confiança dos terroristas. Suas ações afetam diretamente a história e o jogo, levando a finais muito diferentes.

FURTIVIDADE INCONFUNDÍVEL, EQUIPAMENTO APRIMORÁVEL

Aproveite a famosa jogabilidade furtiva de Splinter Cell, melhorada com protótipos aprimoráveis de dispositivos e armas, incluindo uma visão noturna aprimorada, com base nas suas escolhas e habilidades secretas.

UM MUNDO DE ESPIONAGEM INTERNACIONAL

Viaje de Xangai e Cozumel ao coração dos EUA, onde cidades como Nova York e Los Angeles são ameaçadas pelos planos de destruição dos terroristas.

AMBIENTES IMERSIVOS

Faça missões sob as águas geladas, em tempestades de areia cegantes e em ambientes repletos de poeira e fumaça.

Observe que os recursos online deste jogo não são mais suportados. Os modos multiplayer e co-op não são mais funcionais.

data.short_description: In the sequel to the 2005 Game of the Year, Splinter Cell: Double Agent, play as legendary covert operative Sam Fisher, infiltrate a ruthless terrorist organization, and destroy it from within.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Supported OS: Originally released for Windows 7, the game can be played on Windows 10 and Windows 11 OS
  • Processor: 3 Ghz Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 3000 (3.5 Ghz Pentium 4 or Athlon 3500 recommended) - Game optimized for dual-processor-enabled computers.
  • System Memory: 1 GB or above (1.5 GB recommended)
  • Video Card: DirectX 9.0c-compliant, Shader 3.0-enabled 128 MB video card (256 MB recommended) (see supported list*)
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c-compatible (EAX recommended) - PC audio solution containing Dolby Digital Live required for Dolby Digital audio.
  • DirectX Version: DirectX® version 9.0c or higher
  • Hard Disk: 8 GB available hard disk space
  • Multiplay: Broadband connection with 128 kbps upstream or faster
  • *Supported video cards at time of retail release: Single Player: ATI X1300 / X1600 / X1800 / X1900, NVIDIA 6200 / 6600 / 6800 / 7300 / 7600 / 7800 / 7900 | Multiplayer: ATI X1600 / X1800 / X1900, NVIDIA 6600 / 6800 /7300 / 7600 / 7800 / 7900
  • Note:Laptop versions of these cards may work but are NOT supported. These chipsets are the only ones that will run this game. For the most up-to-date minimum requirement listings, please visit the FAQ for this game on our support website at: .

reviews.review:
Just horrible. A definition of Ubi Slop.

- The ragdoll physics glitch all the time
- The game is very prone to crashing
- A lot of the graphics options can't be toggled on or off, so why even have them? 
- The final cutscene will not play unless you lower the resolution to 4:3, instead the game just freezes
- Enemies can do a very sudden 180 degree phase turn and alert the entire area in 0.2 seconds
- Enemies can get into an audio loop, repeating the same phrase over and over
- The removal of the shadow meter makes it so that you're never quite sure if you're visible or invisible, and enemies will very easily spot you, in some missions resulting in an instant game over
- The swimming is horrendous to control
- Sam will constantly get stuck in the environment, such as chairs
- Choosing a specific gear for the current situation is cumbersome and slow due to the crap interface
- The 3D map is horrendous to read due to not being able to rotate it; plus it displays information wrong
- The bonus mission has a wobbly, drunken camera probably just to piss you off
- The game is more action-oriented than the previous games and it encourages you to participate in gunfights (even throwing you into a literal warzone at one point): yet, if you do, at the end of the mission it penalizes you for having done that
- The story is by far the most stupid of the bunch and has a few infuriating plot points

An obvious contender for the worst game in the franchise. Do yourself a favor and just skip this one.
